# 👉Join Discord: discord.gg/lastbone

Welcome to Last Bone — a chaotic multiplayer VR brawler where silly skeletons fight, explore a bigger world, and survive long enough to become the last bone standing☠️
[media]


🐕 MEET STRANGE CREATURES

The wild is full of strange life. Some creatures can become companions and help carry what you find. Others may not be so friendly. Raise your animal companions, explore together, and watch out for dark skeleton creatures hiding beyond the next corner.

[media]

💥 CHAOTIC BRAWLS, NO RULES

Jump into fast-paced multiplayer fights full of random events, shifting situations, and complete nonsense. Dodge attacks, turn the fight around, or survive long enough to become the last bone standing.

[media]
🦴 USE ANYTHING AS A WEAPON

Rip off your own arm (or try stealing someone else’s) as a weapon. Experiment in the Arm Factory to forge new gear and create increasingly ridiculous ways to fight.

[media]

🌏 A BIGGER WORLD TO GET LOST IN

The bones are no longer stuck in small arenas. Explore forests, caves, ruins, giant skeleton remains, and hidden corners packed with loot, discoveries, and places worth getting distracted in.

MORE BONES. MORE CHAOS. MORE STORIES TO TELL.
